opening: I have pain in my right calf muscle.
The pain started a few days ago.
I fell down and scratched my right leg.
It feels like pressure and spasms.
My right leg seems to be warmer compared to my left.
I have felt warm recently, but I haven't measured my temperature.
A week ago, I had a 15-hour flight to see a crucial client.
I've been using oral contraceptives for the past 2 years.
My dad had a clot in his leg.
